review: The fixed-a completion routine returns 1 on the retained three-line decoder where independent exhaustive checking and a valid two-line witness give 2: it maximizes the integer bitmask rather than popcount. Correct the objective, add the regression and regenerate affected exact/search receipts before acceptance.
completion_box uses the same integer-mask objective and also needs correction.
The fixture named=16 and exact family-gap=2 claims inherit the bounded CL3 scan, not a family upper bound.
Finding box-valued attaining witnesses does not prove every attaining label pair is in the box. The code checks selected witnesses. Narrow to existence or supply universal verification.

A Form-R search attaining 10 does not show at least one missing line needs strictly interior box labels when whether Form-R reaches 11 is explicitly open. Distinguish the displayed witness from all possible witnesses.
Different observed gaps at different (k,v) do not exclude an additive function of (k,v), or every lifting inequality. Remove the claimed general exclusion.
limits: Counterexamples invalidate stated components, not all finite witnesses or F-star itself. No new frontier conclusion.
